actions.description: Configure the datapath macro and working directory in a local run configuration without publishing or copying the author-specific path.

actions.description: Acquire and prepare author-named public inputs through the documented routes, confirming the FDIC candidate page exposes the specified annual SOD product before staging it.
steps: For BLS, stage the LAUS county series fields used by the code for 2018–2020.
For FDIC, check the listed official custom-download candidate and stage annual 2011–2022 branch files with year, state, branch ZIP, and deposits if the product is available there.
For CSSE, stage the US county confirmed-case time series through 2020-12-31; do not substitute an unrelated COVID measure.
For CFPB, stage the complaint fields and date windows already specified by the source code.
validation: Check the consumed keys/fields and date windows at each source-to-Stata conversion; retain version/value validation for the documented CFPB ZIP update.

actions.description: Ask whether the documented June 16, 2021 CFPB ZIP assignment must be preserved, or whether current post-2023 ZIP values are acceptable for exact reproduction.
steps: Request the author’s preferred source vintage or an authorized 2021 export if exact historical ZIP assignment is required.
If the current public dataset is accepted, record that ZIP values for historical complaints may reflect the later Census-based update.
validation: Verify date, ZIP, product, company, state and complaint-ID fields and compare any available source-vintage documentation before accepting the panel.

actions.description: Request the exact county-to-ZIP crosswalk source/vintage, fips/zip key format, res_ratio meaning, and uniqueness/coverage rule used by both transforms.
steps: Obtain the crosswalk file or author specification for weights that allocate county cases, labor force, and unemployment to ZIP5/ZIP3.
Keep this mapping separate from the ZIP3-to-state display map.
validation: Confirm the documented weight semantics and keys match both joins before building either transformed panel.

actions.description: Request the source, annual construction, residual-adjustment definition and fields for censuspanel_zip3_residual.dta.
steps: Obtain a producer file or a precise author-supplied construction for zip3_num/year and the demographic/population fields consumed downstream.
validation: Confirm its annual keys and field meanings before using it in the complaint panel.

actions.description: Request the producer/source and exact definition for unemployment_monthly.dta, including the monthly rate and one-month lag.
steps: Obtain the monthly ZIP3 panel keyed by zip3/yearmonth and identify how unemploymentrate_zip3_l1m is constructed.
validation: Confirm it is not substituted with the packaged lag1 field or the annual lag product.

actions.description: Request the producer/source and exact annual lag definition for unemployment_lag1yr.dta.
steps: Obtain the ZIP3/year panel and identify the year/reference period behind unemploymentrate_zip3_l1yr.
validation: Confirm the annual measure remains separate from monthly l1m and the packaged monthly unemployment panel.

actions.description: Request the missing firmsize producer and exact annual-row selection; use the already available local COMP.FUNDA fields as a compatible raw component without treating them as a completed firmsize file.
steps: Use the locally available COMP.FUNDA file at ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat; its native fields are gvkey, datadate, fyear, at, sale, mkvalt, csho, and prcc_f.
Confirm the fiscal-year/datadate selection and one-row-per-gvkey rule before constructing the separate firmsize working input.
validation: Verify the confirmed output's unique GVKEY rule and required fields; do not invent a latest-year selection.
Keep the native COMP.FUNDA availability separate from the unresolved firmsize row-selection/output contract.

actions.description: Request the author-provided company_zip_month_unemploy20220601.dta or its exact producer and variable definition.
steps: Confirm the company_cfpb/zip3/ym keys and the exact d_post_ne_priunemploy2019h1_0601 field.
Do not rename the similarly named base-panel field unless the author confirms identical construction.
validation: Verify the exact requested field and its construction before the Table 4 merge.

actions.description: Request authorized access to the restricted IDVdata.dta analysis panel and its producer/schema.
steps: Ask the authors or authorized data custodian for a permitted copy and the full regression-panel variables/keys expected by the supplied direct use.
Confirm that the file contains idv_board_av plus the Table 5 outcome, controls and zip3/frstmo/gvkey keys, or obtain the documented merge-preparation step.
validation: Check the authorized file’s exact field set and provenance before using it.

actions.description: Stage the packaged unemployment ZIP3 product under the alternate _0601 basename for the Gallup branch after confirming its complete schema and date keys.
steps: Use the package’s unemployment_zip3.dta as the matching six-field product and place a working-copy alias at unemployment_zip30601.dta for the second merge.
validation: Confirm zip3/yearmonth plus current, lag1, 2018 and 2019H1 rate fields; compare the dated output’s values/vintage as ordinary validation.

actions.description: Install and verify winsor2, which is required in both supplied entry-point scopes and is unavailable in the registered environment proof.
steps: Add winsor2 to the intended Stata ado environment using an authorized package source.
validation: Confirm winsor2 resolves in the intended Stata environment before executing either supplied workflow.

actions.description: After all required inputs, unresolved producer contracts, source-option fixes, and software setup are addressed, run the complete documented workflow in stage order.
steps: Stage census.dta and all public/local source inputs in the configured working copy.
Run data_input.do first so its complaints, ZIP3/COVID/unemployment and company panel outputs exist before their first consumers.
Then run t1_to_t6.do, preserving all supplied table branches.
validation: Confirm every input has a compatible route, generated writers precede first consumers, and no branch was silently omitted.

actions.description: Use the exact packaged prepared-file route to attempt Tables 1–6 without Data_input.do only after the three genuine missing analysis inputs and ordinary setup are resolved.
steps: Stage the exact packaged prepared DTA/XLSX files under the local data directory and stage the matching unemployment alias for the Gallup branch.
Resolve the separate firmsize, company unemployment-adjusted panel, and restricted IDV analysis-panel contracts.
Configure the local datapath, install/verify winsor2, and run only t1_to_t6.do; frameappend is not used by this entry point.
validation: Confirm each table input is present with all consumed fields and record that execution itself remains unverified.

actions.description: Install and verify frameappend for Data_input.do preparation; the analysis_only entry point has no frameappend call.
steps: Add frameappend to the intended Stata ado environment using an authorized package source before running Data_input.do.
validation: Confirm frameappend resolves before running the full preparation entry point; it is not a prerequisite for analysis_only.

import delimited "...\sod_deposit\ALL_2011.csv", clear

evidence.description: The code converts branch ZIP to ZIP3, sums deposits by ZIP3/year, and creates the long panel fields.
evidence.quote:
gen zip3 = int(zipbr/100)
sort zip3 year
by zip3  year: egen deposit_zip3 = sum(depsumbr)
gen zip3_num = zip3
sort zip3 year
duplicates drop zip3 year, force
// rename year _year
gen year_deposit = year

evidence.description: The BLS preparation block reads a dated county-level LAUS import.
evidence.quote: use bls_county_20220601.dta, clear

evidence.description: The code derives FIPS from series IDs and separates labor-force and unemployment series.
evidence.quote:
gen _series_id_last2digit = substr(series_id,19,2)
drop if _series_id_last2digit == "05"
drop if _series_id_last2digit == "03"
drop if period == "M13"
capture drop fips
gen fips =  real(substr(series_id,6,5))

evidence.description: The code extracts the labor-force count series from the LAUS value field.
evidence.quote:
keep if _series_id_last2digit == "06"
gen laborforce =real(value)
sort year period series_id
keep year period laborforce fips
frame copy default bls_laborforce, replace

evidence.description: The code extracts unemployment counts and pairs them with labor force on year/period/FIPS.
evidence.quote:
keep if _series_id_last2digit == "04"
gen unemployment = real(value)
drop series_id footnote_codes _series_id_last2digit
drop value

frlink 1:1 year period fips, frame(bls_laborforce)
frget laborforce, from (bls_laborforce)

evidence.description: The code constructs the monthly key from LAUS year and period.
evidence.quote:
gen month = real(substr(period,2,2))
capture drop yearmonth
gen yearmonth = 100*year + month

evidence.description: The BLS transformation joins county-to-ZIP weights and aggregates labor force and unemployment by ZIP3/month.
evidence.quote:
joinby fips using county_zip_link.dta

sort zip yearmonth 
gen laborforce_zip5 = laborforce*res_ratio
gen unemployment_zip5 = unemployment*res_ratio

gen zip3 = int(real(zip)/100)
sort zip3 yearmonth zip

by zip3 yearmonth: egen laborforce_zip3 = total(laborforce_zip5)
by zip3 yearmonth: egen unemployment_zip3 = total(unemployment_zip5)

drop laborforce_zip5 laborforce unemployment_zip5 unemployment zip

gen _unemploymentrate = unemployment_zip3/laborforce_zip3
sort zip3 year month
drop county fips res_ratio
duplicates drop zip3 yearmonth, force

evidence.description: The preparation code writes the monthly ZIP3 unemployment panel under the dated basename.
The COVID code reshapes date columns to daily county counts and retains FIPS/date values.
evidence.quote:
reshape long d, i(fips) j(_date) string

gen _date2 = subinstr(_date, "_", "/", .)

gen date = date(_date2,"MDY", 2022)
format %td date

sort fips date

rename d number

drop _date uid iso2 iso3 code3 admin2 province_state country_region lat long_ _date2

evidence.description: The transformation limits county daily cases to December 31, 2020.
evidence.quote: drop if date > date("20201231","YMD")

evidence.description: The COVID code joins county FIPS to the county-ZIP weight file and weights county cases by ZIP.
evidence.quote:
joinby fips using county_zip_link.dta

sort fips yearmonth zip
gen case_number_zip5 = number*res_ratio

preserve
sort zip yearmonth
by zip yearmonth: egen zip_covid_mon = total(case_number_zip5)
duplicates drop zip yearmonth, force
keep zip yearmonth zip_covid_mon

evidence.description: The COVID code creates monthly ZIP3 cases and a one-month lag before saving.
evidence.quote:
by zip3 yearmonth: egen zip3_covid_mon = total(case_number_zip5)
duplicates drop zip3 yearmonth, force
keep zip3 yearmonth zip3_covid_mon 
*yearmonth_lead1
sort zip3 yearmonth
by zip3: gen zip3_covid_mon_lag1 = zip3_covid_mon[_n-1]
replace zip3_covid_mon_lag1 = 0 if yearmonth == 202001
save covid_jhu_zip3_month_casenumber.dta, replace

evidence.description: The builder selects the 2012 through February 2020 date window and creates monthly/year keys.
evidence.quote:
generate _date = date(datereceived, "YMD")
format %td _date
sort _date
drop if _date < date("20120101", "YMD")
drop if _date >= date("20200301", "YMD")

evidence.description: The complaint builder uses source ZIP codes to construct ZIP3 and monthly complaint counts.
evidence.quote:
generate non_numeric = indexnot(zipcode, "0123456789X")
sort non_numeric zipcode yearmonth
drop if non_numeric != 0 
drop non_numeric
gen _zip3 = real(substr(zipcode, 1,3)) if substr(zipcode,-1,.) == "X"
gen _zip3b = real(substr(zipcode, 1,3)) if substr(zipcode,-1,.) == "-"
gen _zip3c = int(real(zipcode)/100)
su  _zip3 _zip3b  _zip3c
replace _zip3 = 0 if _zip3 ==.
replace _zip3b = 0 if _zip3b ==.
replace _zip3c = 0 if _zip3c ==.
gen zip3 = _zip3+_zip3b+ _zip3c
drop _zip3 _zip3b  _zip3c
sort zip3 yearmonth 
egen nb_totalcomplaints_mon = count(complaintid), by (zip3 yearmonth)

issues.description: Data_input.do reads census.dta, but its adjacent Census CSV import and save commands are commented. The matching 2018 NHGIS raw CSV is packaged, so a working-copy staging/conversion step can supply the expected DTA.

The long deposit writer saves deposit_zip3_20112022.dta with zip3, year_deposit and deposit_zip3; its first consumer merges the same complete key/value product as deposit_zip3_2011to2022.dta. This is a supported filename alignment.
Eight supplied use statements specify replace, while Stata's use syntax permits clear/nolabel. Change only those exact option tokens to clear in a working copy.
The analysis entry point expects a configured datapath macro and working directory. Configure a local working-copy path without copying or publishing the author-specific root.

county_zip_link.dta is first consumed by the county COVID transform and later by the unemployment transform. Required fields are fips, zip, and res_ratio; the crosswalk source/vintage, weight meaning, and key uniqueness are not supplied.

censuspanel_zip3_residual.dta is a separate annual ZIP3 panel joined on zip3_num/year. Its residual-adjusted measure definitions and producer are not supplied, and the static 2018 package panel does not establish it.

unemployment_monthly.dta supplies current ZIP3/month unemployment and the l1m measure. No producer or measure definition is supplied; it is distinct from the packaged one-month lag field named unemploymentrate_zip3_lag1.
unemployment_lag1yr.dta supplies a separate ZIP3/year unemploymentrate_zip3_l1yr value. No producer or annual lag definition is supplied; it is not the monthly l1m product.

The supplied code requires a separate firmsize file unique by gvkey, but does not state which Compustat fiscal-year/date row to select. Local COMP.FUNDA raw fields are available; do not infer a latest-year or other selection rule.

The Table 4 merge requires company_zip_month_unemploy20220601.dta and d_post_ne_priunemploy2019h1_0601. The packaged company_zip_month.dta has a similar but differently named interaction and no supplied producer for the required product.

The Table 5 IDVdata.dta file is absent. Author documentation identifies joint proprietary IDV data; code then runs the regression directly on that file without a merge, so the required full panel fields/keys and authorized route are unresolved.

The author documents a June 16, 2021 CFPB download; official release notes say historical ZIP values were updated in 2023 based on 2019 Census ACS. Because the code assigns complaints to ZIP3, author confirmation is needed on whether the current public values are acceptable for exact reproduction.
